d:
A romantic duet that brings alive the magic of love and togetherness! “Jaane Jaan Dhoondta Phir Raha” from the 1972 film Jawani Diwani is an evergreen Bollywood favourite featuring Randhir Kapoor and Jaya Bhaduri. Beautifully sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle, this melodious duet captures the playful romance and musical brilliance of the 70s.
